cas_objects.description: DailyMed human prescription part-6 archive from the 21 July release.
Caller-supplied NLM RxNorm full monthly release for 6 July 2026.

description: Open mined corpus, full-type NER supervision, source-held-out recognition evidence, and exact terminology/graph retrieval overlays available on 2026-07-22.

rebuild_steps.command: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --extra data --extra retrieval --extra ml
rebuild_steps.description: Restore the exact Python environment and all local data/model adapters.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data registry validate --registry data/sources/mining_registry.yaml --processing-index data/sources/processing_status.yaml --repository-root .
rebuild_steps.description: Validate source licenses, processing dossiers, and checked-in run configs.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data run --plan configs/mining/vietbioner.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Restore the immutable Vietnamese source archive and parsed documents.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data run --plan configs/mining/codiesp.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Restore the immutable CodiEsp source archive and parsed documents.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data run --plan configs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Restore the official SPL-to-RxNorm crosswalk.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data mapping compile-dailymed-rxnorm --artifacts outputs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17/artifacts.jsonl --store "$CLINGROUNDER_ARTIFACT_STORE" --output outputs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17/compiled_mappings.jsonl --index-output outputs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17/dailymed_rxnorm.sqlite3 --report-output outputs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17/compilation_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Rebuild the official versioned SPL-to-RxNorm mapping and derived query index.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data run --plan configs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Restore and parse the executed full-release prescription tranche.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data run --plan configs/mining/rxnorm-full-2026-07-06.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Import the caller-supplied licensed July RxNorm ZIP into the selected CAS.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data artifact materialize --store "$CLINGROUNDER_ARTIFACT_STORE" --sha256 53523ee9f1fcd7ee426698edf566aedebe548a6ec8cc372c41271fc5b28e784c --expected-byte-size 259313098 --output .cache/clingrounder/release-inputs/RxNorm_full_07062026.zip
rebuild_steps.description: Restore the pinned RxNorm CAS object to a local seekable archive for RRF readers.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data label propose --documents outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/documents.jsonl --adapter clingrounder.mining.labelers.dailymed:create_dailymed_structured_labeler --adapter-config configs/mining/labelers/dailymed-structured.yaml --output outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/structured_annotations.jsonl --batch-size 256
rebuild_steps.description: Rebuild bounded-memory exact structured annotation supervision.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data snapshot freeze --documents outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/documents.jsonl --annotations outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/structured_annotations.jsonl --artifacts outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/artifacts.jsonl --source-fingerprint 3c72512e43c1e298c53874bb1d0884dcd8a695c9234890fc769c5054f58bdeb6 --version dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1 --created-at 2026-07-22T00:00:00Z --output-dir outputs/mining/snapshots/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1 --development-fraction 0.2 --hash-salt dailymed-rx-part6-structured-v1 --dedup-mode exact --manifest-only --skip-agreement-gate
rebuild_steps.description: Recreate the exact-dedup train/development split used by every downstream probe.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data mapping compile-rxnorm-ndc --source .cache/clingrounder/release-inputs/RxNorm_full_07062026.zip --source-version rxnorm-full-2026-07-06 --expected-source-sha256 53523ee9f1fcd7ee426698edf566aedebe548a6ec8cc372c41271fc5b28e784c --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/rxnorm_ndc_rows.jsonl --index-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/rxnorm_ndc.sqlite3 --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/rxnorm_ndc_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Stream active package NDC attributes from the pinned full RxNorm archive.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data mapping link-dailymed-products --documents outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/documents.jsonl --dailymed-mapping-index outputs/mining/dailymed-rxnorm-2026-07-17/dailymed_rxnorm.sqlite3 --rxnorm-ndc-index outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/rxnorm_ndc.sqlite3 --links-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/product_links.jsonl --decisions-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/product_link_decisions.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/product_link_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Link products only when exact SPL/version and normalized NDC evidence intersect.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data lexicon build --documents outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/documents.jsonl --annotations outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/structured_annotations.jsonl --split-manifest outputs/mining/snapshots/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1/manifest.json --split train --min-occurrences 1 --min-documents 1 --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_mention_inventory_all.jsonl --conflicts-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_mention_conflicts_all.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_mention_report_all.json
rebuild_steps.description: Aggregate only the frozen train split into a source-label-aware mention inventory.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data knowledge compile-recognition --inventory outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_mention_inventory_all.jsonl --policy configs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-recognition-singletons-2026-07-22.yaml --baseline-dictionary data/standards/phase1_seed_tt06_rxnorm_controlled_concepts.jsonl --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/recognition_singletons_concepts.jsonl --decisions-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/recognition_singletons_decisions.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/recognition_singletons_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Compile code-free DailyMed drug terms from the pinned train inventory.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data knowledge benchmark-recognition --documents outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/documents.jsonl --annotations outputs/mining/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21/structured_annotations.jsonl --baseline-dictionary data/standards/phase1_seed_tt06_rxnorm_controlled_concepts.jsonl --additional-dictionary outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/recognition_singletons_concepts.jsonl --entity-type DRUG --split-manifest outputs/mining/snapshots/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1/manifest.json --split development --require-document-metadata spl_fields --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/recognition_singletons_benchmark_development.json
rebuild_steps.description: Evaluate the train-only dictionary on held-out structured product documents.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data lexicon propose-dailymed-product-aliases --links outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/product_links.jsonl --split-manifest outputs/mining/snapshots/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1/manifest.json --split train --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_proposals.jsonl --decisions-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_decisions.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Build exact product alias hypotheses from linked products in the frozen train split.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data lexicon propose-dailymed-product-aliases --links outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/product_links.jsonl --split-manifest outputs/mining/snapshots/dailymed-human-rx-part6-2026-07-21-structured-silver-v1/manifest.json --split development --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_alias_proposals.jsonl --decisions-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_alias_decisions.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_alias_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Build held-out linked aliases for retrieval evaluation without training leakage.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder terminology build --source data/standards/rxnorm/processed/rxnorm_full_07062026_concepts.jsonl --output .cache/clingrounder/terminology/terminology-0000a0a5bf3f1286c3f2.sqlite3 --manifest-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/base_terminology_manifest.json
rebuild_steps.description: Build the derived full-RxNorm lexical index from canonical JSONL.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data knowledge compile-aliases --proposals outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_proposals.jsonl --index .cache/clingrounder/terminology/terminology-0000a0a5bf3f1286c3f2.sqlite3 --source data/standards/rxnorm/processed/rxnorm_full_07062026_concepts.jsonl --policy configs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-product-aliases-2026-07-22.yaml --overlay-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_overlay.jsonl --recognition-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_recognition.jsonl --decisions-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_compilation_decisions.jsonl --report-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_compilation_report.json
rebuild_steps.description: Promote only globally unique product aliases against the pinned base index.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder terminology build --source data/standards/rxnorm/processed/rxnorm_full_07062026_concepts.jsonl --alias-overlay outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_overlay.jsonl --output .cache/clingrounder/terminology/terminology-c750ca7121eda394a91f.sqlite3 --manifest-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/enriched_terminology_manifest.json
rebuild_steps.description: Build a derived lexical index with the train-only DailyMed overlay.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder terminology query-set --linked-proposal outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_alias_proposals.jsonl --reference-alias-overlay outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_overlay.jsonl --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_queries.jsonl --manifest-output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_queries_manifest.json
rebuild_steps.description: Freeze linked held-out aliases as neutral retrieval queries and seen/unseen slices.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder terminology benchmark --index .cache/clingrounder/terminology/terminology-0000a0a5bf3f1286c3f2.sqlite3 --source data/standards/rxnorm/processed/rxnorm_full_07062026_concepts.jsonl --queries outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_queries.jsonl --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/base_product_retrieval_benchmark.json --limit 20
rebuild_steps.description: Benchmark canonical full-RxNorm lexical retrieval on held-out product aliases.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder terminology benchmark --index .cache/clingrounder/terminology/terminology-c750ca7121eda394a91f.sqlite3 --source data/standards/rxnorm/processed/rxnorm_full_07062026_concepts.jsonl --alias-overlay outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/train_product_alias_overlay.jsonl --queries outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/development_product_queries.jsonl --output outputs/mining/knowledge/dailymed-rx-part6-rxnorm-2026-07-22/enriched_product_retrieval_benchmark.json --limit 20
rebuild_steps.description: Benchmark the train-only overlay on the same held-out retrieval queries.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data dataset fuse --plan configs/mining/open_corpus_v1.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Fuse the source-specific curated outputs after following their dossiers.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder model inspect-token-classifier-run --config configs/models/open-corpus-full-type-xlmr-base-2026-07-19.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Validate pinned model inputs and print the immutable checkpoint prefetch command.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run hf download FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base --revision e73636d4f797dec63c3081bb6ed5c7b0bb3f2089
rebuild_steps.description: Cache the immutable upstream checkpoint before the offline training stage.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder model train-token-classifier-run --config configs/models/open-corpus-full-type-xlmr-base-2026-07-19.yaml
rebuild_steps.description: Optionally reproduce the local checkpoint on a compatible Linux/CUDA worker.

rebuild_steps.command: uv run clingrounder data release verify --manifest data/releases/open-ner-retrieval-v1.lock.json --root . --store "$CLINGROUNDER_ARTIFACT_STORE" --require-cas-objects
rebuild_steps.description: Verify all restored or rebuilt release bytes without machine-local paths.
